versions.changelog:
- Initial release of file-integrity skill.
- Provides automatic MD5/SHA checksum verification after file copy or download to ensure integrity.
- Supports hashing, post-copy check, post-download check, and generation/verification of checksum manifests (compatible with GNU md5sum/BSD formats).
- Offers six subcommands: hash, verify, copy, download, record, check.
- Implemented in pure Python standard library; no third-party dependencies.
